name: Bird Island Airfield
groundLayout: IBRD is a single-runway airfield (Runway 8/26) with no lettered taxiway system - a small apron area runs alongside the runway on its northwest side, connecting directly to the FBO ramp and a Hangar roughly mid-field. Aircraft taxi along that apron/runway edge to reach the FBO or hangar. No taxiway letters exist here - never invent one.
